song.title: O Come, O Come, Emmanuel (tune VENI EMMANUEL)

source.notes: SATB on two staves (upper = S+A, lower = T+B). Eighth-note pickup (the edition notates the tune in eighths). Source MIDI tempo is 60 qpm; overridden to 80 qpm for play.
